description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Change the business’s name, the owner’s name, the owner’s mobile (where Latchbell reaches the owner; customers never see it), the business’s ZIP code or its service_area (the cities or areas it works in, in the owner’s words, e.g. "San Francisco, San Jose and Austin": what its AI receptionist tells customers who ask where it works). For an account an AI agent registered, listed sets whether find_businesses lists it. Only the fields given change, at once, except a new mobile: it waits for the owner’s OK in their dashboard (waiting_for_owner), since Latchbell reaches the owner there. The sign-in email changes only through support. Read my_business first.

listed.description: Only for an account an AI agent signed up itself: true lists it in find_businesses once live, false takes it out

phone.description: The owner’s mobile, with area code

service_area.description: The cities or areas the business serves, in the owner’s words

name: update_business
title: Update my business details
